title: Manual Isolation of Nuclei from Human Brain Using CellRaft Device and Whole Genome Amplification
author: Ester Kalef-Ezra

steps.title: Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 mg - 50 mg of frozen brain tissue into a microcentrifuge tube containing 500 µL of NIM using forceps with the lid on. Gently triturate the tissue using a 1 mL pipette tip, repeating the process 3-4 times with different cut sizes until the tissue can pass through an uncut pipette tip.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization
steps.instruction: Measure the total volume with a 1 mL pipette and add Triton X-100 (10% stock) to reach a final concentration of 0.1%. Homogenize the sample using 2 mL Dounce tissue grinders.

substeps.instruction: Perform 2-3 strokes with Grinder A (loose, large clearance pestles).
Perform 8-12 strokes with Grinder B (tight, small clearance pestles).

steps.title: Nuclear Pellet Isolation
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenate to a fresh 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 1000 x g for 8 minutes at 4 °C. Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Iodixanol Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet gently in 700 µL of 25% Iodixanol Solution. Using a 1 mL syringe without a needle, slowly layer this sample onto 700 µL of 29% iodixanol solution to create two distinct phases. Spin at 10300 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Nuclear Fraction Recovery
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant, leaving 50 µL at the bottom of the ultracentrifuge tube containing the nuclear fraction.

steps.title: Nuclear Staining and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 1000 µL of ice-cold PBS containing DAPI (final concentration 1 µg/ml) and incubate for 20 to 60 minutes at 4 °C. Use a haemocytometer to estimate the number of nuclei and ensure they are mostly single with minimal debris.

steps.title: Nuclear Immunostaining (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform immunostaining if required for the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pelleted nuclei in 500 µL of pre-chilled Blocking buffer.
Incubate at 4 °C for 30 minutes with gentle shaking on a rotator disk.
Add primary antibody at optimal concentration and incubate at 4 °C for 1 hour with gentle shaking.
Pellet nuclei at 800 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C, remove supernatant, and resuspend in pre-chilled PBS to wash.
Pellet nuclei again and discard supernatant.
Add 2 µg/ml goat anti-mouse and/or anti-rabbit secondary antibody and 1 µg/ml DAPI diluted in Blocking buffer; incubate for 1 hour at 4 °C with gentle shaking.
Wash excess PBS by pelleting nuclei and resuspending in fresh PBS/PIC.

steps.title: CytoSort Array Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform the following steps in a PCR cabinet to minimize contamination. Remove the pre-sterilized CytoSort array from its sealed pouch.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 2 mL dH2O, incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature, and remove water (repeat twice).
Apply 1 mL of 15 µg/ml Cell-Tak in PBS with 2.5 mM NaOH, incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature, and remove Cell-Tak.
Wash with 2 mL sterile PBS 1x, incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature, and remove PBS (repeat 3 times in total).

steps.title: Nuclei Seeding
steps.instruction: Dilute approximately 5000 nuclei in 2 mL of PBS (count via haemocytometer first to ensure a nuclei:wells ratio of 1:2 or 1:3) and pipette dropwise into the center of the CytoSort Array. Move the array carefully to ensure even settlement.

steps.title: Array Incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the array using parafilm, paper towel, and foil to prevent desiccation. Allow it to settle for 2 hours or overnight in the fridge (stable up to 336 hours).

steps.title: Raft Selection and Release
steps.instruction: View the array under 10x magnification with fluorescence filters to select rafts containing a single nucleus. Individually release the rafts of interest.

steps.title: Raft Collection and Transfer
steps.instruction: Use a magnetic wand to capture and transfer rafts into 0.2 mL tubes containing the required buffer for scWGA. Centrifuge the tubes briefly.

substeps.instruction: Place the magnetic wand in DNase-I diluted solution to reduce cross-contamination.
Wash the wand with 70% EtOH and then with dH2O between transfers.
Visually inspect tubes under a stereoscopic microscope to ensure rafts (small orange squares) are at the bottom and not on the wall.

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Include the following controls: Negative control 1 (tube with no raft, wand dipped in array fluid), Negative control 2 (raft with no nucleus), and Positive control (15 pg genomic DNA).

steps.title: Sample Preservation or Amplification
steps.instruction: Freeze samples at -80 °C or proceed directly to scWGA using PicoPlex (R300670, R300672, R300722), dMDA (with heat denaturation and Buffer Generation), or PTA (with step 7 incubation for 20 minutes at room temperature).
